newsitem.title: USA: Wyser-Pratte calls for Pennzoil sale vote.
newsitem.headline: Wyser-Pratte calls for Pennzoil sale vote.

text.p: Guy P. Wyser-Pratte said Wednesday that a shareholder "town meeting" will be organized for stockholders of Pennzoil Co to hold a referendum on whether the company should be put up for sale.
"The Union Pacific Resources offer has created an extraordinary opportunity for Pennzoil shareholders to realize value on their investment," he said in a news release.
"The Pennzoil board should not make a final decision on its response to the offer without finding out what shareholders think," Wyser-Pratte said.
Wyser-Pratte said he expected the meeting to be held after the Labor Day holiday on Sept 1.
Wyser-Pratte is the beneficial owner of about 150,100 shares of the company's common stock.
